TUBE_M.name: TUBE M wall light
TUBE_M.housing_note: assumption: no dimensions on sheet 40; box from the product photo proportions (~2.5:1), glow on the top and bottom faces (up/down light)

LINE_PURPLE.name: Range LINE 2019
LINE_PURPLE.housing_note: length 1.0 m per sheets 33/40; section 30x40 assumed (typical linear wall-washer, photo sheet 40), glow on the front (lens) face

FOCUS.name: Range FOCUS 6035
FOCUS.housing_note: lengths 0.5/0.3 m per sheets 33/40; section 60x35 assumed from the model number 6035 and the photo (bar on two brackets)
FOCUS.emissive_srgb_source: RGB fixture; static colour from the render sheet 38 view 2 (warm white on the ribs)

PLAT_A4.name: PLAT-A4 projector

PLAT_A4.housing_note: assumption: no dimensions; drawn pitch 0.30 m, square projector on a U-bracket (photo sheet 40)
PLAT_A4.emissive_srgb_source: RGB fixture; static colour from the render sheet 38 view 2 (warm white on the ribs)

DECO.name: DECO wall projector
DECO.housing_note: assumption: no dimensions on sheet 40; wall-pack from the photo, glow on the bottom lens

choices: 2000K vs 2700K: legend of sheet 33 kept as drawn - light-green swatch (175,218,165) = 2000K = belt +4.72 over the metal facade (S, x 0.3..41.9); mid-green (103,152,112) = 2700K = parapet of the upper (wood) volume S and N. Render sheet 38 view 3 confirms: metal belt glows amber (sample [254, 204, 79]), upper parapet pale warm ([254, 221, 137]), upper belt near white 4000K ([254, 241, 215]). Sheet 34 legend lists only 2700K/4000K and uses them the same way (N upper volume).
Range LINE counted as drawn: one 1.0 m fixture per 9.36 pt rectangle; a run can be modelled as one continuous strip of its nominal length
FOCUS rows alternate 0.3 m / 0.5 m bars (sheet 33 both legend entries share one colour; separated by drawn length)
RGB fixtures (FOCUS, PLAT-A4) get one static colour for ERM: warm white sampled from render sheet 38 view 2 (the only colour shown in the renders)
3rd coordinate: facade planes from pilot parts v002 (FBX-measured); point fixtures: plan sheet 35 symbol centres (symbol stands ~0.2 m proud of the face - snap to the face)
z: centre of the drawn symbol; lines are drawn centred on the level line (parapet +13.92 / belt +4.72) - mount the housing just under the parapet flashing / on the belt
Housing sizes: only lengths are given on sheets 33/40; sections are assumptions (see fixture_types.*.housing_note)
open_questions: Axis 2: the booklet dimensions read 1-2 = 4400, 2-3 = 4000 (axis 2 at x -4.0), the task coordinates use -4.4. Axis 2 is not used as an anchor here (interpolation 1->3).
PLAT-A4 power: 10.5 W on sheet 33 vs 5 W on sheet 40 (geometry not affected).
DECO P(south) at x -2.57, z 4.12 and a 1 m 4000K line over a small canopy at x -1.9..-0.9, z 3.08 are on the south view only (west annex entrance); not on plan sheet 35; y -19.77 is an estimate.
DECO at y -21.92 (west elevation) vs -22.68 on plan sheet 35: 0.76 m apart; elevation value used.
East corner TUBE M: elevation y -49.36 / +1.93 vs plan sheet 35 y -48.06 / +0.63 (1.3 m apart, both near the rounded ground-floor corners); elevation value used along the facade, plan for depth.
East TUBE M x2 at x 74.1 sit in the entrance niche (niche wall x ~73.1-76.0), z 1.96.

Corners R3.15 of the upper volume are drawn in both adjacent views (S/E and N/E): projected lengths overlap by ~3.15 m per corner; along the arc ~5 fixtures fit, not 6-8 drawn. Place by developed length.
Sheet 34 view 6-1 (skewed north wall, developed) has no fixtures; north line y on the skewed part is taken from the sheet-35 TUBE fit.

Arktos x6: booklet shows them as grey 0.5-0.6 m boxes (not in the lighting legend) on the +4.72 joint; render sheet 38 view 3 shows them dark (unlit) against the 2000K belt. They are not booklet luminaires; keep as geometry with ERM R black unless the user says otherwise.
